[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Wed 19:17): Sperrung auf A100-Brücke | Gedenken an 7. Oktober | Kritik von Woidke
item.description:
Originally published Wed 07 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Schon wieder ist eine Brücke der A100 von einer Sperrung betroffen. Diesmal sind es die äußeren Fahrbahnen der Rudolf-Wissell-Brücke. Weitere Themen: Gedenken in Berlin an Opfer des Hamas-Angriffs auf Israel vor drei Jahren. Brandenburgs Ministerpräsident Dietmar Woidke (SPD) und Innenminister Jan Redmann (CDU) fordern eine Kehrtwende der Bundesregierung. Und: Der Nobelpreisträger Peter Hegemann, Bio-Physiker an der Humboldt-Universität, äußert sich zum Wissenschaftsstandort Berlin.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 18:10): Israelis mark three years since 7 October attacks
item.description:
Originally published Wed 07 Oct 2026 18:10 IDT.

Israel has been remembering the deadliest single day in its history on 7th October 2023 when Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups stormed communities along the border with Gaza, killing more than 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages. The anniversary comes weeks before an election in which the question of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's personal culpability for the country's worst-ever security failure will be a central issue.

Also: the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has described Moscow's latest round of attacks on his country as ''the Russian army's birthday gift for Vladimir Putin''. The World Health Organization has requested more information from Russia following unconfirmed reports that a second employee at a plague research lab in Siberia has contracted pneumonia. Malaysia pushes ahead with a ‌controversial move to repatriate thousands of migrants from Myanmar, where they could face persecution. The BBC visits a men's community group in South Africa where participants are encouraged to speak out about violence against women, and confront their own behaviour. Scientists Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai have been awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry. And could the gender pay gap extend to AI agents?
